question: What is the purpose of the freewheeling diode across an inductive load in a controlled rectifier?
solution: When the thyristors turn off, the inductor current cannot change instantly; the freewheeling diode carries it and clamps the load voltage near zero, preventing large L(di/dt) spikes and improving the input power factor.
